description: place_distance for an intra-Pennsylvania pair (e.g. the state 'Pennsylvania, United States' and the county 'Schuylkill, Pennsylvania, United States'). Matches when BOTH standard places contain 'Pennsylvania'. Returns a short in-state distance so the timeline's geographic-feasibility check completes instead of hitting fixture_not_found when it computes a state<->county consecutive pair. Distinct from the Ireland<->Pennsylvania fixtures, which require 'Ireland' on one side.
